# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
project/
├── Dockerfile
├── .dockerignore
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── src/
    └── index.ts
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# ============================================
# Stage 1: Base — shared foundation
# ============================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS base

# Set non-root user for security
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && \
    adduser  -u 1001 -S nodeuser -G nodejs

# Use a consistent working directory
WORKDIR /app

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Dependencies — install all deps
# ============================================
FROM base AS dependencies

# Copy only package files first (layer cache optimization)
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install ALL dependencies (including devDependencies for build)
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Builder — compile TypeScript
# ============================================
FROM dependencies AS builder

# Copy TypeScript config and source code
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/         ./src/

# Compile TypeScript → JavaScript
RUN npm run build

# ============================================
# Stage 4: Production deps — lean install
# ============================================
FROM base AS prod-dependencies

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install ONLY production dependencies
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --omit=dev && \
    # Clean npm cache to reduce layer size
    npm cache clean --force

# ============================================
# Stage 5: Final — minimal runtime image
# ============================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS final

LABEL maintainer="your-team@example.com" \
      version="1.0.0"                    \
      description="Node.js TS App"

WORKDIR /app

# Recreate non-root user in the final image
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && \
    adduser  -u 1001 -S nodeuser -G nodejs

# Copy only what's needed to run the app
COPY --from=prod-dependencies --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder           --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/dist         ./dist
COPY --chown=nodeuser:nodejs package.json ./

# Switch to non-root user
USER nodeuser

# Expose application port (adjust as needed)
EXPOSE 3000

# Healthcheck — verify the app responds
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
    CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1

# Use exec form to handle signals correctly (not shell form)
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## .dockerignore

```dockerignore
# Version control
.git
.gitignore

# Dependencies (will be installed fresh in container)
node_modules

# TypeScript output (rebuilt in container)
dist
build

# Environment files
.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# Logs
logs/
*.log
npm-debug.log*

# Testing
coverage/
.nyc_output/
**/*.test.ts
**/*.spec.ts
__tests__/

# Development configs
.eslintrc*
.prettierrc*
jest.config.*
nodemon.json

# Docker files themselves
Dockerfile*
.dockerignore
docker-compose*

# Editor artifacts
.vscode/
.idea/
*.swp
*.swo

# OS artifacts
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# CI/CD
.github/
.gitlab-ci.yml
```

## Supporting Files

### package.json
```json
{
  "name": "my-ts-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node-dev --respawn src/index.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2",
    "ts-node-dev": "^2.0.0"
  }
}
```

### tsconfig.json
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": false        
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts"]
}
```

### src/index.ts (minimal example)
```typescript
import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';

const app  = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

app.use(express.json());

app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.status(200).json({
    status : 'healthy',
    uptime : process.uptime(),
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
});

app.get('/', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({ message: 'Hello from TypeScript + Docker!' });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});
```

## Build & Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build \
  --target final \
  --tag my-ts-app:latest \
  --tag my-ts-app:1.0.0 \
  .

# Check final image size
docker image ls my-ts-app

# Run the container
docker run \
  --rm \
  --name my-ts-app \
  --publish 3000:3000 \
  --env NODE_ENV=production \
  my-ts-app:latest

# Run in detached mode with restart policy
docker run \
  --detach \
  --name my-ts-app \
  --publish 3000:3000 \
  --env NODE_ENV=production \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  my-ts-app:latest

# Inspect layer sizes
docker history my-ts-app:latest

# Run a specific build stage (e.g., for debugging the builder)
docker build --target builder --tag my-ts-app:debug .
docker run --rm -it my-ts-app:debug sh
```

## Stage Summary

| Stage | Purpose | Artifacts Kept |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | Alpine + user setup | Shared config |
| `dependencies` | Install all `node_modules` | All deps + devDeps |
| `builder` | `tsc` compilation | `dist/` output |
| `prod-dependencies` | Clean production install | Production `node_modules` only |
| `final` | Runtime image | `dist/` + prod `node_modules` |

## Key Optimizations

- **`node:20-alpine`** base → ~180MB vs ~1GB for `node:20`
- **`npm ci`** instead of `npm install` → deterministic, faster, lockfile-safe
- **Separate production deps stage** → dev tools never reach the final image
- **`.dockerignore`** → prevents local `node_modules`/`dist` from leaking in
- **Non-root user** → security best practice, required by many registries
- **Layer cache ordering** → `package*.json` copied before source code, so dependency layers are only invalidated when deps change, not on every code edit
- **`sourceMap: false`** in `tsconfig.json` → smaller `dist/` output in production
